context: Saito explains body temperature to a patient.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: medical explanation; vocabulary (生物/温度/骨/描か/馬) in natural home.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 先生、最近、体が冷えやすくて。
lines.en: Doctor, lately my body gets cold easily.
lines.style: concerned office man voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 体の温度を、保つことが大切です。
lines.en: Keeping your body temperature is important.
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm reassuring measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Does it affect the bones too?
lines.style: curious office man voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 骨は、適度な運動で丈夫になります。
lines.en: Bones get strong with moderate exercise.
lines.style: clear doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 人も生物だから、温度が大事なんですね。
lines.en: Since humans are organisms, temperature matters.
lines.style: understanding office man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: この図に、骨の構造が描かれています。
lines.en: This diagram depicts the bone structure.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 乗馬は、体にいいですか?
lines.en: Is horse riding good for the body?
lines.style: curious office man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 馬に乗るのも、良い運動になりますよ。
lines.en: Riding a horse is good exercise too.
lines.style: warm doctor voice, soft warm caring closing clarity throughout
